verdict.rationale: Qualcomm provides an AI-specific developer ecosystem (AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub with 300+ optimized models, GenieX toolkit) and a general developer portal for Windows-on-Snapdragon, showing some official optimization guidance for AI workloads. But there's no evidence of mature general-purpose compiler support (no mention of Arm64 Windows toolchain maturity, LLVM/MSVC parity, or broader OS-tier-one status), and the chip itself hasn't shipped yet (PCs due 2026), so 'tier one' ecosystem claims are unverified by any independent developer experience. missing for 10: evidence of mature general compilers/toolchains beyond AI SDKs, independent developer corroboration, confirmation OS/tooling treats it as tier one outside AI-specific stack.
